Title: Verify add Grey Jacket to cart and checkout payment details
Preconditions: User has network access to storefront with empty cart
Steps:
1. Open browser and navigate to homepage https://sauce-demo.myshopify.com/
2. Click on 'Grey jacket' product
3. Click 'Add to Cart' button
4. Verify header cart counter increments to 'My Cart (1)'
5. Navigate to /cart and verify product title 'Grey jacket', price '£55.00', and quantity '1'
6. Click 'Check Out' button
7. Verify checkout page loads with contact, delivery, and payment order details
Expected Result: Product added to cart with correct price details and checkout page renders order details and payment options
Test Data: URL: https://sauce-demo.myshopify.com/ | Product: Grey jacket | Price: £55.00 | Qty: 1

Title: Verify updating Grey Jacket quantity in cart recalculates line total and subtotal
Preconditions: Grey jacket is added to cart session
Steps:
1. Navigate to /cart with Grey jacket present
2. Locate quantity input and enter '2'
3. Click 'Update' button
4. Verify line total and subtotal update to '£110.00'
Expected Result: Cart quantity updates to 2 and line total/subtotal recalculate to £110.00
Test Data: URL: https://sauce-demo.myshopify.com/cart | Product: Grey jacket | Updated Qty: 2 | Expected Total: £110.00

Title: Verify cart counter and item persistence across page navigation and refresh
Preconditions: Grey jacket is added to cart session
Steps:
1. Add Grey jacket to cart
2. Verify header counter shows 'My Cart (1)'
3. Reload page or navigate to catalog
4. Verify header counter remains 'My Cart (1)' and /cart still retains Grey jacket
Expected Result: Cart session persists across reload and navigation with item retained and counter at 1
Test Data: URL: https://sauce-demo.myshopify.com/ | Counter: My Cart (1) | Persistence: True

Title: Verify removing item from cart clears cart and updates counter to zero
Preconditions: Grey jacket is present in cart session
Steps:
1. Navigate to /cart
2. Click remove item action ('x')
3. Verify cart displays empty message 'It appears that your cart is currently empty!'
4. Verify header counter updates to 'My Cart (0)'
Expected Result: Grey jacket is removed, empty message appears, and counter resets to 0
Test Data: URL: https://sauce-demo.myshopify.com/cart | Action: Remove | Expected Counter: My Cart (0)
